This audit does not claim to discharge the original four-provider obligation.

stop_rule: Stop at the one source-bound Boolean endpoint witness, actual terminal predicate and byte-preserving opt-in guard. No wider schema census, full native/compiler replay or supplier admission.
evidence: Four actual predecessor export/staging fixtures; compiled exact native JSON terminal predicate rejects final true at role 0; initial false is normalized by staging. The new public wrapper preserves all three baseline and XOR-pair export artifacts and rejects Boolean endpoints before delegation. Three deeper semantic controls and nine boundary test groups pass.
